title: PACE%2BCode%2BA%2B2023.pdf — section 19
text:
2.12 Authority for a constable in uniform to stop and search under section 60 of the Criminal
Justice and Public Order Act 1994 may be given if the authorising officer reasonably believes:
(a) that incidents involving serious violence may take place in any locality in the officer’s
police area, and it is expedient to use these powers to prevent their occurrence;
(b) that persons are carrying dangerous instruments or offensive weapons without good
reason in any locality in the officer’s police area; or
(c) that an incident involving serious violence has taken place in the officer’s police area, a
dangerous instrument or offensive weapon used in the incident is being carried by a
person in any locality in that police area, and it is expedient to use these powers to find
that instrument or weapon.
